subject: Vendor setup: StormWave AP requirements, invoice headers & PO handling

Subject: StormWave vendor registration & PO SW-9812

Hi Rafael,

We're trying to get Redwood set up as a supplier in StormWave's AP system so we can issue PO SW-9812 and get your invoices paid on our standard 30 net terms. Attached: AP-Enrollment_Form.pdf (our intake), and the PO we intend to push once your vendor record is live.

A couple quick questions up front so we can avoid multiple rounds of rework:
- What invoice header fields do you require (legal name, remit address, tax ID, bank details)?

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the PO. We can get you live quickly; below is the vendor evidence checklist and the invoice/transport options we support. I've attached our standard Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet for your AP team.

Key vendor evidence (minimal):
- Legal company name and remit address (for the vendor record)
- US tax form: W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN if foreign; VAT number for EU entities
- Remittance instructions (bank/ACH details or confirmation that a virtual card will be used)

Invoice transport and format options (preferred order):
1) HTTPS delivery to our e-invoice endpoint (we provide a tokenized endpoint for customers to POST invoices) — best for real-time acceptance and automatic remittance reconciliation.
2) SFTP drop — nightly batch processing (CSV or UBL/Invoice XML).
3) EDI 810 (we support basic 810 payloads; mapping may require our EDI team).

For PO handling: we support PO reference in the invoice header (field PO_NUMBER). We can also return a PO-ACK via X12 997 / custom acknowledgement if StormWave requires formal acceptance before payment.

Immediate next steps I suggest: 
- You return the completed AP-Enrollment_Form with W-9 attached.
- We return a vendor ID and remit instructions (Redwood Inference Inc., ACH / bank details) and a short EDI/HTTP field map.
- If StormWave requires XML/EDI, I will loop in Laura to align mappings and field truncation rules.

I'll provision the vendor ID as soon as we have the AP form and W-9.

Best,

Rafael Mendes
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StormWave vendor registration & PO SW-9812 — field mapping note

Looping in a quick note on mapping and header constraints from Finance Tech (so we don't have to iterate with StormWave multiple times):

Important StormWave mapping constraints we've seen with other customers:
- Their system truncates the "description" line item at 90 characters; any structured metadata should go into a separate "line_note" element or the invoice-level JSON payload.
- They expect remit-to to be a single line: "Redwood Inference Inc. | Remit: ACH <account masked> | Attn: AR" — please confirm if our bank wants any additional beneficiary name.
- PO_NUMBER must be in the invoice header, not the body. Their validator will reject invoices missing PO_NUMBER.

Action items for Rafael / Sales Ops:
- Collect the completed AP form + W-9 from StormWave and upload to the vendor record (we'll redact SSN where present).
- Confirm whether StormWave requires a PO acknowledgement (PO-ACK) as a pre-payment gate. If yes, Finance will need to sign-off on automation.
- If StormWave wants EDI 810, attach EDI_field_map.csv (attached) and we'll schedule a short mapping call — Ben, can you take the mapping runbook?

I'll also publish a short Confluence checklist for this account. HubSpot link below for the customer record.

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Manager, Finance Integrations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: EDI_field_map.csv
